mapper.sql: n.ncr_id, n.ncr_no, n.source, n.lot_id, l.lot_no, n.item_id, i.item_cd, i.item_nm, n.unit_cd, n.insp_id, h.insp_no, n.defect_id, d.defect_cd, d.defect_nm, n.nc_qty, n.description, n.occurred_at, n.status, n.hold_yn, n.apr_id, a.status as apr_status, a.requester_id as apr_requester_id, n.closed_at, n.closed_by, n.cancel_reason, n.created_at, n.created_by, n.row_ver, n.src_type, n.src_id, n.src_qty

from qms_ncr n join lot_master l on l.lot_id = n.lot_id join mst_item i on i.item_id = n.item_id left join qms_defect d on d.defect_id = n.defect_id left join qms_insp h on h.insp_id = n.insp_id left join apr_request a on a.apr_id = n.apr_id

where.if: and (n.ncr_no ilike #{keywordLike} escape '\' or l.lot_no ilike #{keywordLike} escape '\' or i.item_cd ilike #{keywordLike} escape '\' or d.defect_nm ilike #{keywordLike} escape '\')

if.test: basis != null and basis != 'CUST_RTN' and basis != 'NO_DEFECT'

mapper.select:
select order by
n.ncr_no n.status n.source l.lot_no n.created_at
desc,
n.ncr_id desc limit #{page.size} offset #{page.offset}
select where n.ncr_id = #{id} for update of n
select capa_id, capa_no, status from qms_capa where ncr_id = #{id} order by capa_no, capa_id
select disp_id, line_no, disp_type, qty, note, rework_lot_no from qms_ncr_disp where ncr_id = #{id} order by line_no
select coalesce((select l.unit_cd = i.unit_cd from lot_master l join mst_item i on i.item_id = l.item_id where l.lot_id = #{lotId}), false)
select status from qms_ncr where ncr_id = #{id}
select lot_id, item_id, unit_cd from lot_master where lot_no = #{lotNo}
select insp_id, lot_id, status from qms_insp where insp_no = #{inspNo} for share
select defect_id, defect_cd, defect_nm from qms_defect where use_yn = 'Y' order by sort_no, defect_cd
select exists (select 1 from qms_defect where defect_id = #{id} and use_yn = 'Y')
mapper.insert: insert into qms_ncr (ncr_id, comp_cd, ncr_no, source, lot_id, item_id, unit_cd, insp_id, defect_id, nc_qty, description, occurred_at, hold_yn, created_by, updated_by) values (#{id}, hb_current_comp(), #{ncrNo}, #{source}, #{lot.lotId}, #{lot.itemId}, #{lot.unitCd}, #{inspId}, #{defectId}, #{ncQty}, #{description}, #{occurredAt}, #{holdYn}, #{by}, #{by})
insert into qms_ncr_disp (comp_cd, ncr_id, line_no, disp_type, qty, note, rework_lot_no, created_by) values (hb_current_comp(), #{id}, #{lineNo}, #{type}, #{qty}, #{note}, #{reworkLotNo}, #{by})
mapper.update: update qms_ncr set status = 'CLOSED', closed_at = now(), closed_by = #{by}, row_ver = row_ver + 1, updated_at = now(), updated_by = #{by} where ncr_id = #{id} and status = #{from} and row_ver = #{rowVer}
update qms_ncr set status = 'PENDING', apr_id = #{aprId}, row_ver = row_ver + 1, updated_at = now(), updated_by = #{by} where ncr_id = #{id} and status = 'OPEN' and row_ver = #{rowVer}
update qms_ncr set status = 'OPEN', row_ver = row_ver + 1, updated_at = now(), updated_by = #{by} where ncr_id = #{id} and status = 'PENDING'
update qms_ncr set status = 'CANCELLED', cancel_reason = #{reason}, row_ver = row_ver + 1, updated_at = now(), updated_by = #{by} where ncr_id = #{id} and status = 'OPEN' and row_ver = #{rowVer}
mapper.select: select ncr_id, ncr_no, status from qms_ncr where src_type = #{srcType} and src_id = #{srcId}
select lot_id, item_id, unit_cd from lot_master where lot_id = #{lotId}
mapper.insert: insert into qms_ncr (ncr_id, comp_cd, ncr_no, source, lot_id, item_id, unit_cd, insp_id, defect_id, nc_qty, description, occurred_at, hold_yn, src_type, src_id, src_qty, created_by, updated_by) values (#{id}, hb_current_comp(), #{ncrNo}, 'CLAIM', #{lot.lotId}, #{lot.itemId}, #{lot.unitCd}, null, null, #{ncQty}, #{description}, #{occurredAt}, #{holdYn}, #{srcType}, #{srcId}, #{ncQty}, #{by}, #{by})
